title: Eatventure: Cooking Games
meta_description: Start your Eatventure & become Idle restaurant tycoon in this Restaurant game
full_description: Do you want to become a restaurant tycoon? And want to become millionaire by managing a successful restaurant business? If yes then don’t wait and play this eat adventure: restaurant game and start earning money, hire cooks, cashiers, upgrade your level and build the biggest restaurant empire in this restaurant simulator.At first you have to start with only a lemonade stand on road like in foodpia tycoon, then you will upgrade to food stand and then a cafe restaurant & be a lemonade tycoon. Then in short time you will progress to drive-thru and Diner! like in offline tycoon games.. & drive thru games.Become the master chef which you always wanted to be by playing this highly addictive game which will provide you a Wonderfull cooking experience! & will lead you to become burger tycoon in this idle cook game.If you like the tycoon games offline then Don’t wait and get into a real cooking craze. Cook like a mad chef in this cooking city. If you are really into the cooking games for kids, offline cooking games, chef games, baking games and cooking games then you can’t get enough of this cooking game And this game is for you! You will serve the delicious dishes like good pizza great pizza to your hungry customers and will get your reward in this cooking restaurant game..Attract more and more customers by serving delicious idle food to them and build your theme park tycoon restaurant empire. You will also practice your cooking and management skills by playing this tastemaker cooking game to become the street food tycoon. Improve your cooking abilities by trying cooking idle and sushi idle and upgrades your dishes and cooking machines in this cooking madness kitchen frenzy for a even more better idle cooking gaming experience of this restaurant simulation game like cooking frenzy and cooking mama..If you have a cooking fever and you like fun cooking games, food cooking games & cooking cake games, then This cooking game will give you endless fun levels which you expect in new cooking games. Maintain your cooking diary Because It will be never boring in this cooking simulator adventure. When you play kitchen games and try to be at top of cooking trends, you will have a lots of fun too!Tap Tap! You have to just tap to cook, serve and increase levels, upgrade machines and unlock interesting features like in Idle games. Join  free cooking games and be adventure capitalist in this money game which have a fast paced gameplay and a lot of fun as you would find in offline idle games to become idle capitalist.Be a star chef, cook and serve delicious food in food court, cheese burgers, pizza, cakes, sandwiches and many more bakery and cafe items. Cook up and get rewarding combos, earn big bonuses, and become a adventure communist in this food adventure game like eatventure.Start humble with running only a lemonade stand to become the CEO and owner of a big empire cash machine cafe restaurant & food tycoon like in food games, coffee games, cafe games and restaurant games. Hire a cashier, cooks and boost your profit and go a way up in this business.   Attract the Investors become the  money land owner & making potential, boost your business and profit.■ Features- Simple, challenging and fun gameplay.- Upgrade restaurants & earn more money.- Cook new recipes to attract more & more customers.- Hire unique chefs and upgrade cooking machines- Open new restaurants after a humble start of lemonade stall- Become a restaurant tycoon & TRILLIONAIRE !!!
